headline.text: The FDA clarithromycin label contraindicates cisapride and reports arrhythmias including QT prolongation; a crossover study found 25 ms QTc increase.

reported.text: The FDA label contraindicates the combination and cites postmarketing arrhythmias.
A 12-volunteer crossover study measured QTc and cisapride concentration increases, and two case reports describe torsades de pointes.

mechanism.text: The FDA label attributes the arrhythmias most likely to clarithromycin inhibiting the metabolism of cisapride.

claims.text: The FDA clarithromycin label says concomitant administration with cisapride is contraindicated.
claims.quote: 2 Cisapride and Pimozide Concomitant administration of clarithromycin tablets with cisapride and pimozide is contraindicated [see Drug Interactions (7) ] .

claims.text: The FDA label describes postmarketing reports of cardiac arrhythmias with clarithromycin and cisapride, most likely from inhibited cisapride metabolism.
claims.quote: There have been postmarketing reports of drug interactions when clarithromycin is co-administered with cisapride or pimozide, resulting in cardiac arrhythmias (QT prolongation, ventricular tachycardia, ventricular fibrillation, and torsades de pointes ) most likely due to inhibition of metabolism of these drugs by clarithromycin tablets.
claims.judgeRationale: The quote reports postmarketing arrhythmias most likely due to inhibited metabolism.

claims.text: In 12 healthy volunteers, combined cisapride and clarithromycin raised QTc by an average of 25 ms and cisapride concentrations 3-fold.
claims.quote: Combination of cisapride and clarithromycin caused an average QTc increase of 25 ms above pretreatment values and 3-fold increases in cisapride concentrations.
claims.judgeRationale: The abstract describes a 12-volunteer crossover, and the quote gives 25 ms QTc and 3-fold cisapride increases.

claims.text: Two case reports describe torsades de pointes after clarithromycin was started in patients on long-term cisapride.
claims.quote: Two cases of torsades de pointes that followed the initiation of clarithromycin therapy in patients receiving long-term cisapride therapy are being reported.
claims.judgeRationale: The quote describes two torsades cases after clarithromycin started on long-term cisapride, and the claim presents them as case reports.
